notes.Giannis Antetokounmpo: He has had two days off since Thursday, when he had 20 points and 14 rebounds in 31 minutes on the second night of a back-to-back. Miami at Sacramento has the highest total on the slate (237.5), and the Kings are without Maxime Raynaud and Ben Simmons.
notes.Bam Adebayo: He has played 31 to 41 minutes in his last three games, including 35 points and 10 rebounds in 41 minutes on Nov. 4. Sacramento is without Maxime Raynaud and Ben Simmons in the slate's highest-total game.
He runs the Sacramento offense on heavy shot volume and had 22 points and 8 assists in 33 minutes Friday after playing 42 minutes Wednesday. Maxime Raynaud and Ben Simmons are out, and Keegan Murray is questionable.
notes.Jayson Tatum: He scored 34 points with 8 rebounds and 9 assists in only 29 minutes Friday. Boston is a 12.5-point favorite at Milwaukee, so a blowout could cap his minutes.
notes.Cooper Flagg: He had 21 points, 10 rebounds and 7 assists in 33 minutes Friday after playing 40 minutes in each of the two games before. Brooklyn is on the second night of a back-to-back after Saturday's game at Atlanta.
notes.Danny Wolf: He got a spot start Saturday at Atlanta and played 31 minutes with 11 points and 9 rebounds, up from 12 to 19 minutes in his earlier games. Coach Jordi Fernandez said Egor Demin will miss at least one more game; Brooklyn's status report for Sunday is not posted yet.
notes.Day'Ron Sharpe: He started Saturday and had his first career triple-double with 12 points, 10 rebounds and 13 assists in 32 minutes. Brooklyn plays the second night of a back-to-back at Dallas, which is without Dereck Lively II.
He scored 18 points off the bench in 25 minutes Saturday at Atlanta. Brooklyn's status report for Sunday's back-to-back game at Dallas is not posted yet.
notes.Brayden Burries: He has started Milwaukee's last three games at point guard with Ryan Rollins on the bench, and he played 38 minutes Friday with 21 points, 11 rebounds and 6 assists. Boston is a 12.5-point favorite, so blowout risk is real.
notes.Malik Monk: His minutes off the Sacramento bench have swung from 18 to 30 in his last three games. Maxime Raynaud and Ben Simmons are out and Keegan Murray is questionable, in the slate's highest-total game.
He played a season-high 24 minutes off the bench Friday with 13 points and 17 rebounds, while starter Daniel Gafford played only 18 minutes for the second straight game. Dereck Lively II remains out.
He has played 21 to 24 minutes in each of Dallas' last three games with Sergio de Larrea out, and de Larrea is out again Sunday with a right knee sprain.
notes.Max Strus: He has played 23 minutes off the bench in both games since returning from his foot injury on Nov. 2. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal and Brandon Ingram again Sunday.
notes.Kobe Sanders: His minutes have swung from 18 to 38 in his last three games, including 26 points in a Nov. 2 start. Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram and Isaiah Jackson are all out Sunday.
notes.Trey Lyles: He played a season-high 29 minutes with 13 rebounds Friday when Joan Beringer played only 7. Beringer is questionable Sunday, and Anthony Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo are out.
notes.Jonathan Kuminga: He played 34 minutes with 17 points and 8 rebounds Friday and has been a heavy-minutes starter with Anthony Edwards out. Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo are out again Sunday.
notes.Luka Doncic: He is questionable Sunday at Detroit with low back tightness after scoring 53 points in 38 minutes Friday. The Lakers play again Monday at Atlanta.
notes.Lauri Markkanen: He is questionable Sunday at Minnesota with a right wrist sprain after playing 34 minutes with 24 points Friday. Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic are out.
notes.Keyonte George: He played 32 minutes with 16 points and 9 assists Friday after a 39-point game in 44 minutes Wednesday. Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic are out, and Lauri Markkanen is questionable.
notes.Nicolas Claxton: He is questionable Sunday against Philadelphia with a left hamstring strain and has not played yet this season. Zach Collins is out with a respiratory illness.
notes.Keegan Murray: He is questionable Sunday against Miami with left ankle capsulitis and has not played since Oct. 23.
notes.Joel Embiid: He is probable Sunday at Chicago after playing 25 minutes Friday. Adem Bona and Ariel Hukporti are out, which thins the backup center spot.
notes.Cade Cunningham: Detroit has not played since Wednesday, when he had 26 points and 11 assists in 40 minutes. Jalen Duren and Isaiah Joe are out again Sunday.
notes.Zion Williamson: He has played 35 to 38 minutes in his last three games. Yves Missi is still out, and the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram and Isaiah Jackson.
notes.Karlo Matkovic: He has started every game since Oct. 29 with Yves Missi out, and Missi is out again Sunday. He scored 18 points in 18 minutes Friday.
notes.Tyler Herro: He had 23 points and 10 assists in 35 minutes Friday and has scored at least 21 points in each of his last three games. Boston is a 12.5-point favorite in Milwaukee.
